title: Extracellular Matrix: Composition, Organization and Cellular Roles
method: Retrieved saved p.teaching-prose elements; Unicode lexical count; headings, diagrams, question/answer content, tables, revision, references and UI excluded. Total article visible count excludes SVG and button text and includes expanded answers. 147 distinct paragraphs; max pairwise word-set Jaccard 0.2661.

comparator.method: Recounted retrieved published HTML and inspected reader architecture. 4.B immediate neighbors were unpublished at baseline; 4.A.13 provided a verified strong same-unit exemplar.

syllabus_references: Separate CSIR-UGC NET Life Sciences Unit 4.C printed p.3
Archived MP SET 2024 Unit 4.C printed p.3
scope_review: Complete roadmap assignment: cell-secreted ECM, interstitial versus basement membrane, collagen, elastin, GAGs, proteoglycans, fibronectin, laminin, attachment, hydration, tissue mechanics, environmental cues and remodeling. Integrin activation and intracellular details reserved for 4.B.05. Syllabus visuals inspected.

coverage_360.historical: Ramachandran/Kartha and Rich/Crick; Pierschbacher/Ruoslahti; Engler et al.
coverage_360.mechanisms: collagen assembly, elastic recoil, GAG hydration, adhesive ligand presentation, network formation
coverage_360.quantitative: stress/strain, energy, hydration, Donnan, diffusion, matrix turnover, chain assembly, ligand partition
coverage_360.evidence: historical records and hypothetical controlled experiments
coverage_360.comparative: animal matrix versus plant walls and bacterial extracellular material
coverage_360.exceptions: GAG exceptions, nonfibrillar collagen, laminin isoforms and context-dependent effects
coverage_360.applications: culture, tissue repair and decellularized matrices
coverage_360.integration: biomolecules, cell adhesion and integrin handoff

review_pass_1: Internal scientific review checked triple helices, fibrillar maturation, LOX, elastin, GAG chemistry, fibronectin motif, laminin and type IV architecture, tissue mechanics and remodeling; equations recomputed and historical claims tied to verified records; experimental examples marked hypothetical.
review_pass_2: Separate editorial review of saved chapter; removed 8 overlapping paragraphs, strengthened 24 distractors and updated explanations, corrected figure connectors/labels, added five references and specific trap reasoning. Static markup, SVG and answer-key audit rerun.

arithmetic_checks.method: Independent JavaScript numerical checks: stress, strain, modulus, elastic work, water fractions, Donnan concentrations and pressure, flux, first-order turnover, probabilities and practice calculations.

academic_self_review.method: Internal editorial judgment: complete roadmap coverage and substantive narrative; one point deducted for incomplete primary full-text access, one for limitations of historical evidence and model approximations, one for lack of examiner calibration, two for lack of interactive browser/mobile and comprehensive accessibility testing.

limitations: Several NCBI pages returned access challenges; checked accessible indexed excerpts, bibliographic records and available scientific source material rather than claiming full-text review of every reference.
MP SET source is archived, not independently verified on current primary MPPSC site.
Internal academic self-review, not external expert peer review; no full interactive browser/mobile or comprehensive accessibility tests.
